chapter_title_en: Stirring the Seas Beyond; Killing Beasts for Their Cores
chapter_seo_title: Five Years of Demon Beast Hunting: Han Li’s Costly Grind in the Outer Star Seas
chapter_meta_description: Han Li spends five years in the Outer Star Seas killing hundreds of fifth-grade demon beasts for their cores, losing puppets, formation tools, and nearly his life in the process.
og_title: The Five-Year Hunt: Han Li’s Demon Core Grind
og_description: A training montage with teeth—puppets lost, formations shattered, and a core count that proves competence isn’t free in the Mortal Stream.
twitter_title: Outer Star Seas: Han Li’s Five-Year Beast-Killing Montage
twitter_description: Hundreds of demon cores, dozens of destroyed puppets, and one close call with a seventh-grade beast—Han Li’s grind is the Mortal Stream’s version of paid-in-full.

lore_anchors.definition: A common fifth-grade demon beast covered in eyes on an urchin-like body; attacks by firing concentrated beams from multiple eyes, but is predictable in defense.
A rare sixth-grade demon beast that nearly stumbled into Han Li’s trap when he over-ripened his bait grass to four hundred years.
A treasure partially refined by Qu Hun; manifests as a yellow crescent blade that can grow into a massive disc for crushing attacks.
Han Li’s most powerful formation, sacrificed to temporarily trap a seventh-grade beast while he fled.
The internal energy condensation of a demon beast; fifth-grade cores are a key alchemical ingredient for high-grade pills in the Outer Star Seas.
The frontier waters of the Starfall Sea where Han Li spends five years hunting, trading safety for rapid resource accumulation.
A set of flying needles that Han Li deploys for precision strikes against weakened opponents.
A spirit herb whose scent attracts demon beasts; excessive ripening beyond three hundred years draws higher-grade, more dangerous monsters.
A trapping formation used by Han Li to contain demon beasts temporarily; weaker than his main formation and quickly damaged.
